name: SubagentSkillDelivery
description: Agent .md files are the PRIMARY skill delivery mechanism for subagents. SubagentStart hook never fires for Task-spawned agents. Skill catalog + role-specific assignments must be in agent .md files. SUBAGENT-PROTOCOL.md template includes full precision-mastery + DPB content.
when_to_use: When updating skill catalog, adding new skills, or modifying how agents discover skills

name: TemplateBasedPromptDeployment
description: claude-md-manager.ts reads prompt files from plugins/goodvibes/templates/prompt/ at runtime. Falls back to minimal hardcoded defaults if templates missing. Prevents session-start hook from overwriting expanded content.
when_to_use: When modifying prompt files or session-start behavior

name: SkillStructure
description: Every skill has SKILL.md (instructions, <5000 words), scripts/ (POSIX bash validators), references/ (detailed material). Body teaches behavior, references hold data.
when_to_use: Creating or reviewing any GoodVibes skill

name: BatchEnginePhaseGroupedSchema
description: batch_engine operations use phase-grouped format: {read: [], write: [], exec: [], query: [], state: []} NOT flat array of {tool, input}
when_to_use: Writing batch_engine examples or documentation

name: POSIXPortableScripts
description: Use printf over echo -e, grep -n over GNU sed ranges, -- before filename args, [[:space:]] over literal spaces, set -euo pipefail
when_to_use: Writing any bash validation script for skills

name: ServiceRegistryNestedConfig
description: Service registry reads config.fetch.services (nested object). Always use addService() function or precision_config set key=fetch with full nested object. Never use flat dot-notation keys like 'fetch.services.OpenAI'.
when_to_use: When adding/modifying services in goodvibes.json via precision_config or direct editing

name: GeminiV1InternalModelNames
description: Gemini v1internal API expects model names WITHOUT 'models/' prefix. Use 'gemini-2.5-pro' not 'models/gemini-2.5-pro'. Only the standard v1 API uses the full prefix format.
when_to_use: When making API calls to Gemini's v1internal endpoints (generateContent, etc)

name: PrecisionFetchRelativeURLBug
description: precision_fetch validates URLs before resolving service base_url, rejecting relative URLs even when service parameter is provided. WORKAROUND: Always use absolute URLs with service parameter.
when_to_use: When using precision_fetch with service parameter - avoid relative URLs

name: OpenAI_ChatGPT_Backend_API
description: ChatGPT Product API at chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/ requires specific headers and constraints: ChatGPT-Account-ID, originator header, stream=true, store=false, instructions field required, input as array
when_to_use: When making API calls to OpenAI using ChatGPT OAuth tokens (not sk-... API keys)

name: GrepPathNotGlob
description: Use path parameter instead of glob for directory-scoped grep searches
when_to_use: When searching for patterns within a specific directory subtree

name: ForceReadAfterEdit
description: Use force:true on precision_read after editing a file to bypass stale cache
when_to_use: Immediately after using precision_edit on a file, before reading it

name: AvoidImageRead
description: Do not read image files with precision_read - ImageContent blocks crash the API
when_to_use: When working with directories containing image files

name: PrecisionExecFullyReliable
description: precision_exec is 100% reliable including background mode, parallel, timeouts, env vars, expectations
when_to_use: When choosing between precision_exec and native Bash for command execution

name: PrecisionWriteFullyReliable
description: precision_write is 100% reliable for all scenarios: batch (18+ files), deep nesting, base64, 512KB+ files, all modes, dry_run, unicode
when_to_use: When choosing between precision_write and native Write for file creation

name: TimerLeakInPromiseRace
description: Always store setTimeout handle and clearTimeout in finally block when using Promise.race for timeouts
when_to_use: When wrapping async operations with timeout via Promise.race pattern

name: GrepFirstStrategy
description: Use RipgrepCore.filesWithMatches() to narrow file list before expensive per-file processing like symbol extraction
when_to_use: When processing many files but only a subset will match a query string

name: CacheInvalidateNotUpdate
description: After writing/editing files, use cache.invalidate() not cache.update() to ensure next read returns fresh content
when_to_use: When precision_write or precision_edit modifies a file that may be cached by FileStateCache

name: RegexWhitespaceMatching
description: For whitespace-insensitive matching, split pattern into tokens, escape for regex, join with \\s+ - more reliable than character scanning
when_to_use: When implementing whitespace-flexible text matching

name: CJSESMCallableGuard
description: When dynamically importing a module in a CJS bundle, use typeof guard chain: typeof mod.default === 'function' ? mod.default : typeof mod === 'function' ? mod : null
when_to_use: Any dynamic import() in code that gets bundled as CJS (esbuild, webpack with CJS target)

name: NormalizeBeforeSimilarity
description: Always normalize whitespace before computing Levenshtein similarity for code matching - prevents false rejections from whitespace-only differences
when_to_use: When using fuzzy/similarity matching for source code text

name: OutputModeFieldCoverage
description: When mapping output modes between tools, verify the target mode includes all fields the consumer needs. E.g., names_only has no file field but discover needs file paths.
when_to_use: When one tool delegates to another with output mode translation

name: NbformatVersionCheck
description: For nbformat 4.5+ features, use (nbformat > 4 || (nbformat === 4 && nbformat_minor >= 5)) — NOT (nbformat >= 4 && nbformat_minor >= 5) which fails for nbformat 5.0 where minor=0
when_to_use: When gating features on Jupyter notebook format version (e.g., cell IDs introduced in 4.5)

name: CellIdTargeting
description: Use cell_id for stable notebook cell targeting: check cell.id first, then cell.metadata.id as fallback. cell_id takes precedence over index when both provided.
when_to_use: When targeting specific cells in Jupyter notebooks, especially in batch operations where index shifts would break subsequent operations

name: CollisionResistantIdGeneration
description: When generating IDs for notebook cells or similar, collect existing IDs into a Set and loop until a unique one is generated. 8-char alphanumeric gives ~2.8 trillion combinations.
when_to_use: When inserting new cells into notebooks with nbformat >= 4.5 that require unique cell IDs

name: IncludeHiddenDefault
description: When adding file search params that toggle hidden/dot file inclusion, default to true (widest net). Apply ?? true in handlers, add exclude patterns when false.
when_to_use: When adding include_hidden or similar toggle params to file search tools

name: YAMLSchemaSync
description: YAML tool definitions must match TS schemas exactly. Use TS schema as source of truth. Check: property names, types, enums, defaults, required arrays. Common drift: output.mode vs output.format, output_mode vs verbosity.
when_to_use: When modifying tool schemas or adding new parameters to precision-engine tools

name: ProjectFileIndex
description: Disk-shared project file index at .goodvibes/project-index.json. Built by session-start hook, read lazily by precision-engine MCP server, updated incrementally by write/edit handlers, queried via discover type:index.
when_to_use: When working with project file discovery, adding new file operations, or modifying the discover handler

name: CrossProcessDiskCommunication
description: Session-start hooks run in a different process than MCP server. Communication via disk files (JSON). Use atomic writes (temp+rename) and lazy loading with version validation.
when_to_use: When adding new cross-process data sharing between hooks and MCP server

name: FireAndForgetHookIntegration
description: Non-critical session-start tasks should be fire-and-forget (no await) with .catch() error handling. This prevents blocking session startup while still performing useful background work.
when_to_use: When adding new non-critical tasks to session-start hooks

name: PrecisionEngineV2Architecture
description: Precision engine v2 absorbs batch engine concepts: file_ops in exec, precision_agent for multi-provider AI, SQLite telemetry, 4 unified hooks, PrecisionRuntime singleton, agent dossier. Design doc: precision-engine-v2-design.md
when_to_use: When adding new features to precision engine or referencing the v2 architecture

name: BatchEnginePhaseGroupedSchemaDeprecated
description: DEPRECATED: batch_engine has been removed. Use precision_engine built-in batching (files array, edits array, commands array) or future precision_apply for unified output.
when_to_use: When encountering batch_engine references in docs or prompts — redirect to precision engine

name: StdinFileShellRedirect
description: Use temp file + shell redirect (< file) for large stdin delivery to spawned processes. ProcessManager.spawn accepts stdinFile option, appends redirect to command. Works with shell: true because shell opens file independently of Node stdio.
when_to_use: When passing large text (prompts, configs) to child processes that would exceed ARG_MAX as positional args

name: ForbiddenFlagBlocklist
description: When exposing CLI flags as pass-through parameters, maintain a Set of forbidden keys that are silently stripped with a warning log. Include both long and short aliases (e.g., model + m, print + p).
when_to_use: When building MCP tools that wrap CLI tools with user-supplied flag overrides
